facts.fact: Evidence Action's facility survey states that all 48 surveyed facilities in Montserrado, Margibi and Grand Bassa fill paper HMIS forms monthly and submit them to the district or county health team's office, where district or county data clerks enter the values into the online DHIS2 database; the records reviewed were for May to July 2022.

Evidence Action's survey reports that 48 of 48 sampled facilities in three counties (100%) report to district or county health teams on paper HMIS forms, the DHIS2 entry being made by district or county data clerks and not at the facility; the sample includes clinics and at least one hospital, and the review covered May to July 2022.

The survey names clinics (Bokay Town Clinic, Gbaye-Ta Clinic) among the 48 facilities whose monthly paper HMIS forms feed the national DHIS2 database, alongside C.H. Rennie Hospital, whose tier it does not give; records reviewed were for May to July 2022.
